signal: Pathlock introduced Pathlock Nexus on June 1, 2026, to govern access across SAP, Oracle, Workday, and 150-plus apps, on the heels of new ServiceNow and Microsoft Sentinel integrations.

email.body1:
Ben, saw Pathlock just launched Nexus to govern access across SAP, Oracle, Workday and 150-plus apps.

A major platform launch usually means more in-market accounts in play than a global team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Pathlock off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ben, quick follow-up for Pathlock.

A launch like Nexus expands the addressable list faster than headcount can keep up, so accounts go untouched globally and the quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the global team needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ben, last bit of proof for Pathlock.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Pathlock reply rate likely compares to other GRC and security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ben, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling global coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a launch cycle is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your global motion? I will tailor it to Pathlock either way.
